booking.submitted: Your request has been sent. {orgName} will get back to you by email to confirm it — an acknowledgement is on its way.

fleet.title: Book with {orgName}
fleet.heading: Book a boat with {orgName}
fleet.intro: Pick a boat to see its availability and send a booking request.
fleet.emptyDescription: This company hasn't opened any boat to online booking yet. Please contact them directly.

pricing.title: Rates
pricing.seasons: Rates vary by season: the quote alongside takes your dates into account.

quote.pickArrival: Pick your arrival date in the calendar.
quote.unavailable: These dates are no longer available. Please pick others.
quote.invalid: These dates can't be booked online.
quote.onRequest: Price on request: the company will give you its price when confirming.
quote.belowMin: This boat is rented for at least {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
quote.aboveMax: This boat is rented for at most {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
quote.total: Estimated total ({count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}})
quote.disclaimer: Indicative estimate: the final price is the one the company confirms.

form.name: Full name
form.messagePlaceholder: Number of guests, sailing experience, questions…
form.consent: I agree that {orgName} uses this information to handle my request. It is deleted within {days} days if the booking doesn't go ahead.
form.datesError: The selected dates aren't valid. Please pick them again in the calendar.
form.noCommitment: No commitment, no payment: the company confirms your request before anything is booked.

emails.footer: This email is sent by {orgName} following your online booking request.
emails.footerStaff: Request received through the online booking page of {boatName}. Without an answer within 30 days, it is deleted.

alert.subject: Booking request: {boatName} — {clientName}
alert.heading: New request for {boatName}
alert.intro: {clientName} requested {boatName} from your online booking page. An option now holds these dates: confirm or decline it, the customer is notified by email.

ack.subject: Your booking request — {boatName}
ack.heading: Request received, {clientName}
ack.intro: Thank you for your request to book {boatName} with {orgName}. The dates are on hold while the company reviews it.
ack.next: You'll get an email as soon as it is confirmed, or if it can't be. No payment has been taken.

confirmed.subject: Booking confirmed — {boatName}
confirmed.heading: Your booking is confirmed
confirmed.intro: Good news, {clientName}: {orgName} confirms your booking of {boatName}.
confirmed.next: {orgName} will contact you about the rental contract and the down payment.

declined.subject: Your booking request — {boatName}
declined.heading: Your request couldn't be confirmed
declined.intro: {clientName}, unfortunately {orgName} can't confirm your request for {boatName} on these dates.
declined.next: Other dates may suit you: the online calendar shows up-to-date availability. No payment has been taken.
